name: Hybrid Distributed-Memory Parallel Volume Rendering
aliases: Hybrid Distributed-Memory Parallel Volume Rendering (Montani et al.)
definition: A distributed-memory parallel volume rendering algorithm that extends Childs et al.'s work to take advantage of many-core architectures and reduce memory costs using partial composites. It works on structured and unstructured grids, designed for unstructured grids prone to load imbalance.
summary: Hybrid Distributed-Memory Parallel Volume Rendering combines object- and image-order techniques to mitigate load imbalance on unstructured grids by bounding work per processor.
